metadata.note: Transferred 1,456,162.068532 USDC to 0xb087269de7ba93d0db2e12ff164d60f0b3675870 instead of the established recipient 0xb087cfa70498175a1579104a1e1240bd947f5870; the two share the first four and last four hex digits. The Safe had paid the intended address 100 and 1,499,900 genuine USDC two days earlier. A third party then manufactured a 1,499,900-unit transfer from the Safe to the lookalike using a fake ERC-20 styled as USDC about 30 hours before the mistaken payment. Fails R-4.3: the recipient is outside the expected target set (§ 2.4).
